cohort: The study included low-risk pregnant women, grand multiparas younger than 35 years, and grand multiparas 35 years and older at Omdurman Maternity Hospital, Sudan.
finding: Younger grand multiparas (<35 years) experienced a similar rate of complications as low-risk pregnancies and significantly fewer complications compared to older grand multiparas (>=35 years), although they had an increased risk of PPH, longer hospital stays, and their babies were more likely to have low birth weight and be admitted to the NICU.
birth_weight: low birth weight (specific values not provided)
